top_signals.title: Dollar Logs Best Day Since September as CPI Lifts Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: The dollar rallied the most since September after hotter-than-forecast US inflation reinforced expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
